header: Where the currency converter's rates come from, said under the converter like every other card says it: the European Central Bank's reference rates (through Frankfurter) and, for the Gulf currencies the ECB does not publish, open.er-api.com (whose free terms ask for a link to Exchange Rate API, given here). Each name is a link to the provider; the date is the date of the rates. I read the text from the rates the server answered with (rates.source), so a provider that did not answer is not named.
